name: hud_sensor_tracker_draw_diamond_marker
description: HudSensorTracker::DrawDiamondMarker builds a closed four-segment diamond around a projected marker center and draws it clipped to the tracker rectangle.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation at 0x415f40 have no warnings or tags and build five integer line-strip points: left center, bottom, right center, top, then left center again.
The direct callee zRndr_DrawClippedImmediateLineStrip is functional-equivalent through target zrndr_draw_clipped_immediate_line_strip.
The native HUD smoke installs a clipped-line raster callback and verifies four emitted diamond segments, tracker clip-rect forwarding, active framebuffer forwarding, and low 16-bit color masking.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x415f40 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
